Training Grounds

Power rankings

    Arrows compare each player's rank with the last closed week. Ratings use Elo: everyone starts at 1000 and each result moves both players by the same amount. Beating a stronger, higher-rated opponent earns many more points (and costs them more); beating a weaker one earns few. Swiss events still score 3 for a win, 1 for a tie. Sprites beside a name are that player's most-used decks.

          League tools

          Closing a week saves the standings so arrows show movement. Reset restores the demo league.

          Add a deck

          Type an existing deck's name to change its sprites instead of adding a new deck. Decks whose name contains a Pokémon name (like imported Discord results) get sprites automatically. With no sprite, a deck gets a generated pixel icon.

          Import Discord results

          Matches already imported are skipped, so you can re-import the latest export any time. New players and decks are added automatically.

          Patreon

          Players listed here get Pro on their account. Automatic unlocking needs the Patreon API on a server, which comes with the website build.

          Social links

          Icons in the site footer stay dimmed until you add a link.

                  Card database

                  Copies about 20,000 English cards into your own database. It takes a few minutes, so keep this tab open. It is safe to run again, for example after a new set is released. Card pictures load from the pokemontcg.io image server and are not stored.

                  Swiss calculator

                  Win = 3 pts, tie = 1, loss = 0. Player counts are the expected spread if every match were a coin flip, so real events will differ.
